bullets: Capped GPT-6.1 Sol at one paid session-hour per Freebucks day for every account, even paid plans, with the limit named in the model picker and pricing notice.
Added a badge field to model picker rows to mark announced models, with a tooltip shown on Desktop and Web pickers.
Set a New badge tooltip on the Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor row reading "New: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3, 1M context, on every paid plan.".
Added an optional note field to the FreebuffFreebucksWindow documenting the reason for the daily pool size.
Added a VPN availability notice stating Freebucks and more models are available on a direct connection.
Shrunk the free Freebucks pool for VPN users compared to the rest of limited access.
Split the referral source chips into separate Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook options, retiring the combined TikTok id.
Named the likely cause when a residential proxy is detected, in place of generic VPN advice.
Set steering messages in progress as mid-turn so models keep the running task.
Showed an Add to the current task placeholder while steering during a run.
Recovered reply-text handoffs during context compaction instead of discarding them.
Allowed model-handoff summaries to run up to twice their requested budget when under the target token limit.
Returned a state snapshot on prompt-error instead of the live session, preventing post-error writes from bleeding into persisted state.
Released an open head think tag as text only when the model finished the step, fixing an answer-swallowing bug.
Tracked when the daily streak bonus Freebucks expire in the reader's local clock, alongside the next streak-day reset.
Added an invoiced CPM value field to placement totals for separately invoiced billboard-style ads.
Updated the Freebuff subscription promotion house ad copy, affecting both seeded campaign text and last-resort fill.
Added UTM attribution tags to advertiser-domain URLs inside saved agentic procedures.
Tagged user messages with their source label for ad auctions, limited to user-typed, step, and error prompts.
Recorded post-click return timing from ad click to the next submitted prompt in the CLI.
Removed the legacy tier change notice from the Freebuff landing screen.
